findings.reason: the condition must be stated per member (each reading postdates that member's own newest text change) or §4's cut is refused by §3's own gate, costing a second full adjudication pass inside a USD 40 ceiling.
findings.text: §3's cut refuses when the group's audited defect rate "was measured before the newest change to any member's stored text", but the same section defines that rate per member, and §4 (line 41) composes the post-repair rate "from the second reading of each member that changed and the first reading of each that did not", so every unchanged member's reading necessarily predates the newest change to another member; a gate implemented at the stated granularity refuses the first group's valid cut or forces a full re-adjudication of all of its members

rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §3's freshness refusal is stated at group granularity while §4 composes the group rate from readings taken at different times, so the gate and the rate it guards cannot both hold as written.
